column1: Baseline line capacity is 31,339 good units/day, set by Filling.
The largest single-lever gain is scenario B (Add 1 machine at the bottleneck) at +11.9% (+3,728 units/day).
The combined scenario reaches +19.2% (+1,888,188 units/year), which is less than the sum of the individual gains because the constraint moves once the bottleneck is relieved.
In scenario B, the constraint moves from Filling to Packaging. Any further spend on Filling alone would add nothing: Packaging now sets the pace.
In scenario F, the constraint moves from Filling to Packaging. Any further spend on Filling alone would add nothing: Packaging now sets the pace.
